used = set(re.findall(r'class="(rag rag-\w+)"', src))
css = set(re.findall(r'\.(rag-\w+)\s*\{', src))
print(f"  used in markup: {sorted(used)}")
print(f"  defined in CSS: {sorted(css)}")

pairs = re.findall(r'<data class="rag rag-(\w+)" value="\w*">([A-Z ]+)</data>', src)
labelmap = {"green": ("GREEN",), "amber": ("AMBER",), "red": ("RED",)}
bad = []
for cls, lbl in pairs:
    expected = labelmap.get(cls, ())
    if expected and not lbl.startswith(expected):
        bad.append((cls, lbl))
print(f"  <data value> vs visible label mismatches: {bad if bad else 'NONE'}")
